fixture.format: CaptureRecord JSON lines (Open/Segment/End of the anthropic-messages streams, chain order); a Segment's data_b64 is written as text (UTF-8, same bytes) for eye review and re-encoded by the test loader

source.harness: Claude Code 2.1.283 (versions/2.1.283, sha256 d8cb1e5c...5651d21e per E01), headless, --model haiku
source.protocol: Anthropic Messages over HTTP/1.1: POST api.anthropic.com /v1/messages (application/json), 200 text/event-stream responses; request 2 is a threaded continuation (thread.type continue, previous_message_id) carrying only the two tool_result blocks
source.capture: T13 proxy, T04 stream redaction, T03 v5 writer; decoded body bytes (chunked framing removed by T10)

same-length placeholders for the message and tool-use IDs and the thinking signature; every part keeps its real length, offset and boundary
re-serialized after eliding the system (billing header) text and metadata.user_id; ID placeholders

placeholders.elided values: <elided: N bytes> with the original UTF-8 length; tool input_schema {}
